tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a sync.day availability poll and get its share link. Candidate days run from startDate to endDate (inclusive; or give days instead). Each day offers candidate START times from hourFrom, every startStepMinutes, as long as start + durationMinutes <= hourTo. Returns slug, public url (share this)

tools.name: parse_event_text
tools.description: Turn a natural-language sentence (Chinese works best) into create_event input using sync.day's AI parser. Does NOT create anything; review the result, then call create_event. Example: '下周六或周日下午聚餐，大概 3 小时'.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Read an event: settings, every candidate start key per day (startOptions), who has answered (participants with their start keys; names may repeat), the top 10 start times by head-count (ranked), the starts EVERYONE with picks can make with their votes (voteOptions), each person's vote (votes) and de

tools.name: submit_availability
tools.description: Save (or replace) one person's availability: the candidate start keys they can make, from get_event.startOptions. The person is identified by `identity`, not by name: the same identity later overwrites the same row (and can rename it), a different identity with the same name is a second participant.

tools.name: remove_participant
tools.description: Organiser only: remove one participant by name (the oldest row with that name when it repeats), together with their vote. Requires the adminKey from create_event.

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Organiser only: change any event settings (same fields and rules as create_event; omitted fields keep their current value; endDate wins over days). Existing picks are kept; those no longer valid starts are just hidden.

tools.name: vote_time
tools.description: Approval voting: set every start one person accepts (replaces their earlier approvals; an empty list clears them). The voter is the `identity` used in submit_availability and must have at least one start saved. Only keys listed in get_event.voteOptions are accepted; the error lists the current optio

tools.name: decide_time
tools.description: Organiser only: settle on a start time (locks availability picking and voting; the page shows 已定). Pass start=null to reopen. Requires the adminKey from create_event.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_event · Private data: create_event · Public sink: create_event, submit_availability · Destructive: create_event, remove_participant.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_event · Private data: create_event · Public sink: create_event, submit_availability · Destructive: create_event, remove_participant

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
